# Merriam-Webster

> The authoritative source for English language definitions, thesaurus entries, slang terminology, and comprehensive reference materials across multiple editions and formats.

Merriam-Webster provides extensive dictionary and thesaurus resources for learners, students, and language enthusiasts, including specialized editions for children, collegiate use, and modern slang. The site offers both digital and physical products, from unabridged comprehensive references to educational materials for schools and communities.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions
- Thesaurus
- Slang dictionary
- Gen Z language
- Trending words
- Collegiate Dictionary
- Word definitions
- Language learning
- Vocabulary building
- Internet slang
- Reference books
- Educational resources
- Student resources
- Social media terms
- SCRABBLE

## Comprehensive Dictionary Resources

- [The Unabridged Dictionary by Merriam-Webster](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com): Comprehensive unabridged dictionary with 700000+ definitions, quotes, and word tools
- [Slang Dictionary - Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Slang dictionary defining trending words, phrases, emojis, and Gen Z language

## Shop & Products

- [Merriam-Webster Dictionaries – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com): Main shop hub for Merriam-Webster dictionaries, thesaurus, and reference books
- [Shop For Dictionaries – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/dictionaries): Product catalog for Merriam-Webster dictionaries including collegiate and learner editions
- [Shop For Thesauruses – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/thesauruses): Product catalog for Merriam-Webster thesaurus editions and combo reference books

## Educational & Children's Resources

- [Shop Titles for Kids – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/elementary): Educational products for children including encyclopedias and vocabulary-building books
- [Support Schools in Your Community! – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/support-the-children-in-your-community): Bulk purchase program offering educational discounts for schools and communities
